#         # dep-graph-dual-log4j-spring-001

        **Suite:** dependency_management | **Type:** dependency_graph | **Difficulty:** hard
        **Repos:** log4j2 + spring-boot

        ## Context

        Log4j2 restructured its bridge modules (log4j-to-slf4j, log4j-api) in
a major release, changing how Spring Boot's logging auto-configuration
detects and configures logging providers.

Your task:
1. Find where Log4j2 defines its API bridge modules
2. Find where Spring Boot auto-configures logging providers
3. Identify how the bridge module restructuring affects detection logic
4. Document the dependency chain from Spring Boot → SLF4J → Log4j2

Write your analysis to /workspace/analysis/IMPACT_REPORT.md

        ## Expected Output

        Write your analysis to `/workspace/analysis/IMPACT_REPORT.md`.

        Your report should include:
        - File paths from each repository that are relevant
        - Specific code symbols, functions, or types involved
        - The nature of each change (removal, rename, signature change, behavioral)
        - Migration recommendations

        ## Hints

        - All repos are cloned under `/workspace/`
        - Focus on import/dependency declarations first, then trace into implementation
        - Check version constraints in dependency manifests (Cargo.toml, go.mod, pom.xml, requirements.txt)


Search only these repositories: github.com/sg-evals/logging-log4j2--rel_2.20.0, github.com/sg-evals/spring-boot--v3.1.0

The report is written. Here is a summary of the findings:

---

## Analysis Complete

### Key Findings

**Dependency chain (default Spring Boot setup):**
```
Application (Log4j2 API) -> log4j-api -> [SPI: SLF4JProvider] -> SLF4JLoggerContextFactory
  -> SLF4JLoggerContext -> org.slf4j.LoggerFactory -> logback-classic -> log output
```
Active `LoggingSystem`: `LogbackLoggingSystem` (Logback wins because `log4j-core` is absent)

**How Spring Boot detects Log4j2:**
[`Log4J2LoggingSystem.Factory`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/spring-boot--v3.1.0/-/blob/spring-boot-project/spring-boot/src/main/java/org/springframework/boot/logging/log4j2/Log4J2LoggingSystem.java?L503-L517) checks `ClassUtils.isPresent("org.apache.logging.log4j.core.impl.Log4jContextFactory", ...)` — a class in `log4j-core`, not in `log4j-api` or `log4j-to-slf4j`. The [default starter](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/spring-boot--v3.1.0/-/blob/spring-boot-project/spring-boot-starters/spring-boot-starter-logging/build.gradle) never ships `log4j-core`, so `Log4J2LoggingSystem` is never activated in the default config.

**The restructuring impact — three SLF4J-related modules now exist:**

| Module | Direction | SLF4J version |
|--------|-----------|---------------|
| [`log4j-to-slf4j`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/logging-log4j2--rel_2.20.0/-/blob/log4j-to-slf4j/pom.xml) | Log4j2 API → SLF4J | any |
| [`log4j-slf4j-impl`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/logging-log4j2--rel_2.20.0/-/blob/log4j-slf4j-impl/pom.xml) | SLF4J 1.7.x → Log4j2 Core | 1.7.25 |
| [`log4j-slf4j2-impl`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/logging-log4j2--rel_2.20.0/-/blob/log4j-slf4j2-impl/pom.xml) (**new**) | SLF4J 2.0.x → Log4j2 Core | 2.0.6 |

**Critical risks introduced by `log4j-slf4j2-impl`:**
1. The mutual-exclusion guard in [`SLF4JLoggerContextFactory`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/logging-log4j2--rel_2.20.0/-/blob/log4j-to-slf4j/src/main/java/org/apache/logging/slf4j/SLF4JLoggerContextFactory.java?L30-L43) checks for `org.slf4j.helpers.Log4jLoggerFactory` (a SLF4J 1.x class) and will **not** catch a routing loop caused by `log4j-slf4j2-impl`
2. [`LogbackLoggingSystem.getLoggerContext()`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/spring-boot--v3.1.0/-/blob/spring-boot-project/spring-boot/src/main/java/org/springframework/boot/logging/logback/LogbackLoggingSystem.java?L379-L390) asserts `ILoggerFactory` is a Logback `LoggerContext` — this throws `IllegalStateException` if `log4j-slf4j2-impl` is on the classpath
3. [`ConfigureClasspathToPreferLog4j2`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/spring-boot--v3.1.0/-/blob/spring-boot-project/spring-boot-tools/spring-boot-test-support/src/main/java/org/springframework/boot/testsupport/logging/ConfigureClasspathToPreferLog4j2.java) hardcodes `log4j-slf4j-impl:2.19.0` — a stale reference that does not account for `log4j-slf4j2-impl`

The full report with all file paths, code symbols, change classification, and migration guidance has been saved to `IMPACT_REPORT.json`.
